name: MSE 3034
title: Ferrous Alloys
description: Application of materials science and engineering principles to extraction, refining, processing, phase transformations, heat treatment, properties and applications of iron-based alloys. Alloys covered include: plain-carbon steels, alloy steels (micro-alloyed, high-speed, stainless) and cast irons.
requirement_description: MSE 3001 and 3003, both of which may be taken concurrently. Open to juniors and seniors.
